column4: Kill three enemies in under 30 seconds. Kills count; merely injuring or knocking out an enemy does not satisfy this challenge.
Kill or knock out five enemies consecutively with melee weapons, without dying.
Kill or injure three enemies with one explosive blast.
Land four fatal headshots during one Combat Focus activation.
Make five drive-by kills within one minute; stay inside the vehicle.
Kill seven unalerted enemies with a scoped sniper rifle; do not die or get arrested.
Burn or injure five enemies with fire within 15 seconds.
Score six revolver headshot kills without reloading or changing weapons.
Shoot three enemies in 10 seconds using a scoped rifle from at least 300 feet.\nRequirement is three kills, not merely hits (PowerPyx / gta.guide).
Kill or injure eight enemies with explosives within 20 seconds without taking damage.
Rob five pedestrians.
Rob three stores in one game day without death or arrest.
Steal three vehicles and take each to Pay n Spray in one day; avoid death or arrest.
Take $500 from pedestrians in one day without dying or being arrested.
Stay wanted for five minutes while driving a stolen police vehicle.
Take trunk weapons from five separate police vehicles without dying or arrest.
Rob two stores in each of the five counties within 20 minutes; avoid death or arrest.
Tow a police vehicle with someone inside for one uninterrupted mile.
Register or respray stolen vehicles from ten different manufacturers at Pay n Spray within 30 minutes; avoid death or arrest.
Earn $100,000 from vehicle fencing or Pay n Spray sales in one day; avoid death or arrest.
Use WAiNK on four distinct landmarks, curiosities or sculptures.
Reach the top of each of Vice-Dale County's five highest towers.
Find three collectible cards in every county.
Discover 100 animals, vehicles and weapons in total.
Find and explore 25 distinct underwater discovery sites; the game lists 33 in total.
Ride a train for one mile in all five counties within a single day; do not skip.
Recover 85 underwater treasures.
Locate all 11 Black Hole wrecks.
Drive through every Leonida city and town in one day; exit only to refuel.
Fly at or below 100 feet over 41 helipads in Vice City and Vice Beach in ten minutes.\nOptional for the 70-challenge completion target; Alcast identifies this as a particularly demanding objective.
Purchase a membership at any gym.
Walk or run five miles during one in-game day.
Cycle 15 miles within one in-game day.
Swim three miles within one in-game day.
Use each kind of gym equipment in a single day.\nComplete each equipment workout rather than only starting the machine.
Keep both Jason and Lucia at Strength level four for five days running.\nBegin early; both characters must maintain the stat simultaneously throughout the five-day interval.
Keep both characters at Cardio level four for five straight days.\nBegin early; both characters must maintain the stat simultaneously throughout the five-day interval.
Run from the Tip pier gate to Waning Sands in less than 13 minutes without taking damage.
Swim from Tequesta Retreat to Starfish Island in under 15 minutes.
Cycle from Williams Guest House in Grayson to Chicky's Tiki Bar, Southwind, in under 22 minutes without falling.
Buy five modifications for a vehicle at a mod shop.
Spend more than $250 at food or liquor stores in one day.
Buy three handguns and three long guns from Ammu-Nation.
Spend more than $1,000 at barbers or beauty salons.
Customize five handguns and five long guns at Ammu-Nation.
Spend more than $5,000 on clothes.
Spend over $20,000 during one vehicle-customization visit.
Spend over $50,000 at Ammu-Nation.
Spend more than $125,000 at vehicle-modification shops.
Hold $1,500,000 in a BuckMe checking account.
Score at three different hoops in a single day.
Finish 18 holes at King Gator or Frontier Adventure Golf in under 30 minutes, at three under par or better.
Sink ten basketball shots in a row within two minutes.
Win pool at three venues in one day, without losing or quitting.
Score at least once in each county.
Finish 18 holes at BOTH King Gator and Frontier Adventure Golf in one in-game day, scoring par or better at each.
Pot a ball after banking the cue ball off three rails.
Score a basket at all 100 numbered hoops.
Win a pool match by potting the eight ball on the break.
Make two consecutive holes in one in the same round at King Gator or Frontier Adventure Golf.
Hunt three wild alligators.
Catch a fish weighing at least 20 pounds.
Earn a shooting-range medal at both ranges in one day.\nReported prerequisite: purchase the $5 Waiver Pass from the clerk at each range to expose events (gta.guide).
Catch three fish with each lure type in one day.
Study twenty different animal species using binoculars.
Catch four fish species in under six minutes.

Earn Gold in the Master class of three different shooting-range events consecutively. Do not fail or quit between events; lower shooting-range difficulties do not fulfill this challenge.\nA $5 range waiver is reported to unlock events at each range; check Master difficulty availability first.
Hunt a boar, rattlesnake and panther in 15 minutes without taking damage.
Catch a specimen of each fish species.

Hunt eight unique animals for this challenge. Nine Snapmatic hunts and two other rare creatures are listed under Activities / Robberies > Legendary Animals; not all necessarily count toward this objective. Check the in-game counter. Fair Game is reported for a first legendary hunt.
Discover six distinct vehicles; WAiNK scans count.
Ride a wheelie for one-quarter mile.
Win one race each in a muscle car, sports car and supercar.
Keep a road vehicle above 100 mph for two minutes.
Jump a motor vehicle more than 100 feet over a drawbridge three times, without exiting the vehicle between jumps.
Reach 175 mph in a car, truck or motorcycle.
Land a plane on a moving train without destroying the plane.\nOptional for the 70-challenge target; no need to complete it unless pursuing all vehicle cheat unlocks.
Jump from an aircraft at least half a mile up, parachute into the Vice City Oceanarium dolphin or orca tank, and survive.
Win three straight races in one in-game day at Thrillbilly Mud Club, Gellhorn International Raceway and Boone Speedway; no quitting or restarting.
Jump a motorcycle at least 75 feet onto a moving train twice within 20 minutes.\nOptional for the 70-challenge target; skipping it prevents the final Vehicle category cheat.
